name: 截面/剖视图

prompt_template.subject: {object_description}
prompt_template.layout: cutaway cross-section revealing internal layered structure
prompt_template.style: detailed cutaway illustration with layered annotation
prompt_template.color_scheme: distinct hues per layer with gradient depth, earth tones for geological
prompt_template.labels: layer names in bold, depths/measurements in regular, leader lines pointing to layers

overrides.style: line-drawing cross-section with leader lines and hatched layer patterns
naturalistic textbook cutaway with realistic textures and colors
3D rendered cutaway with realistic materials, lighting, and depth
simplified infographic cross-section with bold color blocks and minimal texture

category_tips.biology: 器官截面按解剖学切面（冠状/矢状/横切）；分层标注组织类型；血管神经走向准确
category_tips.medicine: 病理截面标注病变区域；正常 vs 病变对比；临床分期标注
category_tips.chemistry: 分子截面显示电子云；晶体结构显示晶格；催化剂截面显示活性位点
category_tips.physics: 装置截面显示内部组件；电磁场分布用矢量；能级用阶梯
category_tips.engineering: 零件截面显示公差和配合；材料层显示复合材料铺层；流道显示流体方向
category_tips.math: 几何体截面显示截面形状；曲面截面显示曲率；拓扑截面显示亏格

examples: Earth cross-section diagram, cutaway revealing 4 layers: crust (thin brown #92400e, 5-70km), mantle (orange-red #ea580c, 2900km), outer core (yellow #eab308 liquid), inner core (red #dc2626 solid). Layer names bold Arial, depths in regular weight with km units, leader lines pointing to each layer. Naturalistic textbook style. 4K.

Human heart cross-section, frontal plane cutaway. 4 chambers: right/left atrium and ventricle. Septum between sides. Valves: tricuspid, pulmonary, mitral, aortic. Major vessels: vena cava, pulmonary artery/vein, aorta. Wall thickness accurate (left ventricle thickest). Red #ef4444 oxygenated, blue #3b82f6 deoxygenated blood. Latin names italic. 3D rendered cutaway. 4K, medical textbook.

Volcano cross-section infographic, cutaway showing: magma chamber at bottom, conduit rising up, vent at top, lava flow on surface, ash cloud above. Side layers: bedrock, sedimentary rock. Simplified color blocks with minimal texture. Bilingual labels 岩浆房 (Magma Chamber). 4K, education style.
accuracy_tips: 分层厚度/深度比例准确；切面方向标注（冠状/矢状/横切）；层名用标准术语；不虚构内部结构；深度/厚度带单位；剖切线清晰；标注引线不交叉。
